rank_context: Calibrated across 15 real matches (41 teamfights) comparing Diamond Losses, Diamond Wins, and Grandmaster Wins. In Grandmaster lobbies, 62.4% of Biotic Grenades are offensive anti-nades and 90.0% of them convert directly into a teamfight win (only 3.3% are wasted in lost poke phases). In Diamond Losses, offensive anti-nade ratio drops to 42.7% and fight-win conversion plummets to 30.0%, driven by two failure modes: (1) throwing early unconverted poke nades before tanks commit (28.0%), or (2) dying passively (1.20 deaths/segment vs 0.60 in GM) without deploying utility.

rules.category: Biotic Grenade Timing & Brawl Conversion (GM 90% Conversion vs. Diamond Loss 30%)
rules.timeline_condition: Flag when: (A) Player throws an `offensive_anti` nade in a fight that is subsequently LOST (`unconverted_poke_nade`), OR (B) Player is forced to spend Biotic Grenade on isolated `self_heal` (`self_heal_ratio >= 0.30`).
rules.diagnostic_template: At [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio} in Fight #{fight_id}, outcome: {fight_outcome}), you used Biotic Grenade on '{actual_target}' ({nade_usage}). Across this match, {unconverted_or_self_summary} (GM benchmark: 62.4% offensive anti-nade ratio with 90.0% fight-win conversion).
rules.actionable_fix: Do not chuck long-range purple nades during early 5v5 poke before your Tank has closed distance—enemy Kiriko/Baptiste will cleanse or wait it out. Hold Biotic Grenade until your Tank commits onto a target or a flanker commits onto you.

rules.timeline_condition: Enemy composition contains dive/flank threat AND (player dies with `sleep_on_cd_when_dove == true` OR fires `is_poke_lottery_sleep == true` in a lost fight).
rules.violation_threshold: sleep_on_cd_when_dove == true OR (is_poke_lottery_sleep == true AND fight_outcome == 'LOST')
rules.actionable_fix: Across our 15-match dataset, every fight where Ana died with Sleep Dart on cooldown resulted in a 100% fight loss, whereas disciplined anti-flanker sleeps converted up to 80-100% of fights into wins. Never fire long-range poke Sleep Darts down main corridors when enemy flankers/dive tanks are alive.

rules.category: Nano Boost Fight Economy (Unconverted Disadvantage Ult vs. Win-Con Turnaround)
rules.timeline_condition: Player activates Ultimate (Nano Boost) when `ally_alive - enemy_alive <= -1` AND `fight_outcome == 'LOST'`.
rules.actionable_fix: Only invest Nano Boost at a numbers disadvantage if it directly enables a teamwipe win-condition combo (e.g. Nano + Dragonblade / Cage Fight). Otherwise, save Nano for the next 5v5 neutral engagement.

rules.category: Unspent Utility Death & Late Disengage (Diamond Loss 1.20 Deaths vs. GM 0.60)
rules.timeline_condition: Player dies (`player_death`) while `sleep_on_cd_when_dove == false` (Sleep Dart held/unspent) AND 0 Biotic Grenades were used in that fight.
rules.diagnostic_template: At [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio}, Fight #{fight_id} {fight_outcome}), you were eliminated by {killed_by} ({dead_allies_context}) while holding unspent cooldowns (0 Biotic Grenades and 0 Sleep Darts deployed in this fight).
rules.actionable_fix: In Diamond Losses, Anas average 1.20 deaths per segment (2x the GM rate of 0.60), frequently dying in 2v4/3v5 collapses without using E or Shift. As soon as 2 allies die on the killfeed, immediately disengage around hard cover or use your cooldowns proactively before lethal burst lands.
